application.destination: A new retained copy only; never external checkout or existing measured result trees.
checks: Verify every original source hash before any replacement.
Each literal replacement must occur exactly once in listed order.
Verify every patched hash and byte count before compilation.
Retain a separate unmodified original header and cpp for the in-binary reference.
Both source copies use the same hash-verified model.h.
application.production_default: P original argmax behavior. Instrumentation storage and counter updates are compiled out unless GAMMA_FX2_ARGMAX_INSTRUMENT=1. No production timing result exists.
application.activation: Only the synthetic probe calls GammaSetArgmaxArm. No production predictor or codec arm selection is added.

mechanism.hypothesis: With an unchanged row, narrowing [bot,top] retains its lowest-index maximum when that cached index survives and the new bot is not NaN; rescanning the exact upstream loop otherwise reduces redundant argmax comparisons.
mechanism.P: Always execute the original strict-greater scan; no cache lookup or seeding in Predict. Optional comparison counters.
mechanism.K: Maintain the same cache and test eligibility, but always execute the original strict-greater scan.
mechanism.D: Reuse an eligible cached winner; otherwise execute the original strict-greater scan.
mechanism.C: Force cache invalidation before every Predict, then use the same bookkeeping and original scan.
mechanism.tie_rule: The original > scan selects the lowest-index maximum, including equal infinities and signed zero ties. Cached selection retains that rule.
mechanism.nan_rule: NaN at bot causes the original scan to keep bot, even if an earlier interval cached a larger surviving index. Detect NaN from IEEE binary32 bits and run the exact scan. Interior NaNs are ignored by the original > comparisons.
mechanism.invalidation: Invalidate at ByteUpdate entry and arm change. Seed lazily in Predict, after subclass post-base normalization. Perceive only narrows bounds.
mechanism.counter_meaning: argmax_comparisons counts the original probs_[i] > max_prob_val evaluations only. Range checks and bitwise NaN checks are reported separately, not credited as absent runtime cost.
mechanism.instrumentation: Compile-time opt-in GAMMA_FX2_ARGMAX_INSTRUMENT=1, required by the unit fixture and omitted for any later codec timing comparison. Count top_-bot_ once after a scan; never insert a counter in the comparison loop. Counter storage and updates are absent without the flag.

audited_update_semantics.finding: Perceive narrows bot/top without changing probabilities; ByteUpdate resets bounds and masks vocabulary.
PPMD::ByteUpdate writes probs, invokes base ByteUpdate, then divides by probs_.sum(); cache must remain invalid until next Predict.
Bracket::ByteUpdate replaces its probability row then invokes base ByteUpdate last.
ByteMixer::SetProbs and ByteMixer::ByteUpdate fill the row then invoke base ByteUpdate last; per-bit row mutation is absent.
Predictor retains byte_mixer_->ex as lstmex; Gamma must preserve the exact expert index.
lstmex contributes to mxA[9].cxt; it is not dead output.

probe.selection: --all-arms; two repeats from independently initialized models, all P/K/D/C in one binary.
probe.reference: Include the retained, unmodified upstream byte-model.h and .cpp under the sole class-name macro ByteModel=GammaPublicByteModel. No copied hand-written reference algorithm.
families: quiet NaNs at newly selected bots 64 and 128 with a surviving cached winner
PPMD-style normalization after base update: positive, overflow and zero-to-NaN rows
probe.paths: Every row exhausts all 256 decoded bytes, eight bits each; Predict twice before each Perceive. Reuse models across byte updates to expose stale cache state.
checks: Compare float probability bits, ex, bot, top and mid against the independent original after constructor/load, every Predict and every Perceive.
Compare all 256 probability bits after each row load.
P/K/C each perform exactly 257024 original > comparisons per row family; D must not exceed that and must reduce total comparisons.
C forces invalidation on every prediction; no control may report cache hits.
Repeat reference state vectors compare exactly word for word, with all arms independently equal to reference in both repeats.
FNV-1a transcript digests are diagnostic; they do not replace exact state comparisons.
The overflow-after-base-update row has pre-normalization winner 200 but becomes all zeros with winner 0; this detects premature cache seeding.
not_covered: signaling-NaN exception flags or floating-point trap modes
probability mutation between Predict calls without audited ByteUpdate invalidation
native full-codec archives, cross-vendor replay or production timing
